# wisp-science v1.21.0 — Context Reuse

**Carry the useful part of a conversation into the next one.** Quote a stretch of turns into a new chat, send it to another conversation or distill it into an editable experience, drag past conversations onto the composer, and hand a long session over with a generated note. This release also adds private project memos, background Runs and a per-conversation Runs tab.

## Reuse conversations

- **Quote / reuse** on a user turn starts a selection and **End quote here** closes it. Start a new conversation with just that stretch attached as quoted context; the source conversation is not modified.
- A selected range can also go to an existing conversation in the same project, or be distilled into an editable **experience** (when it applies, steps, how to verify, limits) that you can optionally save to project or global memory. Quotes and experiences are staged in the destination composer for you to send.
- Drag a sidebar conversation onto the composer to attach it as a reference; drag a group to attach every conversation in it.
- The composer `#` picker now finds archived and older conversations, ranks title matches first, favors the current project and says when nothing matches.
- A **session health line** notices when a conversation keeps compacting while each pass frees less room and suggests splitting it. **Handoff summary** generates an editable note with the goal, finished work, decisions and open items, then opens a new session with it.
- The agent can open a **branch of its own conversation** that keeps everything said so far, for you and that branch's agent to continue. The parent does not wait for it.

## Project memos

- Notes inside a project that only you see: pitfalls, a standing prompt opener, how a server is used. Open them from the right-pane **Memos** tab or the `/memo` picker.
- The agent never reads a memo. It is not injected into turns, exposed to any tool, written to the workspace or included in recaps and exports. A memo reaches the model only when you paste it into the composer and send it. See [project memos](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/project-memos.md).

## Runs and compute

- **Move to background** on an active Run card ends the turn's wait without cancelling the Run. The conversation accepts new messages, the card stays live, and you are told when the Run ends. See [Run cards](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/run-cards.md).
- A **Runs** tab in the conversation's right pane lists its Runs and transfers, working ones first, with a count badge.
- **Cluster schedulers**: `sbatch`, `qsub` and `bsub` jobs are submitted through an SSH Run wrapper, so the Run follows the real job's exit code and logs, and cancelling the Run cancels the job.
- `run_in_context` preflight no longer fails when an interpreter cold-starts slowly, such as R loading Bioconductor packages. On Windows the `shell` tool no longer reports exit 1 for a successful command whose stderr is merged into the pipeline.

## Agents and delegation

- Delegation is always available in built-in conversations. The composer's Delegation switch and Delegated tasks setting are gone; the agent chooses per call whether delegated work runs in the background and is always resumed when background results arrive. The composer Agent menu is regrouped.
- Subagents inherit the parent conversation's model, reasoning effort and service tier. Deleting a parent can delete its subagents and branches together with their artifacts.
- Failed Reader tasks can be retried in place from the swarm card, **Agents → Parallel tasks** or the failed assistant's page. Reader retries malformed or incomplete JSON once.
- Sustained exploration is routed to subagents rather than bounded workflows. Workflow retries get a fresh deadline; local desktop workflows no longer inherit an implicit 600-second deadline or 256,000-token budget, keep usage across timeouts and retry upstream failures returned inside HTTP 200 responses.
- **Specialists** can be exported and imported as `.wisp-specialist.json` files (**Settings → Specialists → Add specialist → Import from file…**). Deleted Specialist, model profile and Workflow template ids are never reused.
- The **research assistant** treats a selected project as a scope instead of re-reading all of its conversations, and answers "where does this project stand" from a project progress memory that the daily recap updates.

## Models and settings

- **Settings → Models → Decision model** configures a System One decision model (TypeSafe Jev, StartLux on Bamboo or self-hosted, or a custom server) for the `map_items` decide step and `desktop_autopilot`. See [model configuration](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/model-configuration.md).
- Gateway models such as Command Code resolve documented context ceilings and reasoning-effort levels automatically from models.dev API base URLs.
- **Notification sound** under **Settings → General → Notifications & updates** plays a chosen sound when a task finishes, fails or needs approval. It is off by default and independent of desktop notifications; WinUI has the same setting.
- Project cards show separate **Needs you** and **Running** counts. Sidebar rows show status text, and a **Needs you** filter lists every pending conversation in the project.
- Agent status colors and motion are consistent across the thread, sidebar and pet, and respect reduced motion.

## Reliability

- A damaged project database (SQLite code 11 / 26) is set aside as `project.sqlite.corrupt-<time>` and restored from the newest daily copy in `backups/`, or rebuilt empty, with a note on what was kept. See [automatic database copies](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/upgrade-backups.md).
- macOS: notifications no longer leave a permanent polling timer on the main thread, which raised `usernoted` CPU and could freeze the app after hours. Packaged builds now write `wisp.log`.
- The browser extension opens a new window when no browser window is left, and recovers from a half-open bridge connection.
- The memo editor keeps focus while typing. WinUI recovers on first launch when the host database is not ready yet.

## Mobile and native

- iOS and Android add a per-device transcript detail level (concise / standard / detailed).
- The SwiftUI transcript keeps tool disclosure and selection state while the conversation updates.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations. Separate SwiftUI DMGs and checksums are also published.
- **Windows**: regular MSI / NSIS installers remain unsigned while release signing is disabled. Separate WinUI 3 preview installers are built by their own release workflow.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Mobile**: the signed [Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.21.0/wisp-science_1.21.0_android.apk) installs over the previous version. Install iOS through Xcode.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.21.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as the platform workflows finish.

[All changes since v1.20.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.20.0...v1.21.0)

# wisp-science v1.21.0 — 上下文复用

**把一段对话里有用的部分带到下一段对话。** 可以把若干轮引用到新对话、发送到另一条对话或提炼成可编辑的经验，把历史对话拖进输入框，并用自动生成的交接说明接续长会话。本版本还新增私人项目备忘录、Run 转到后台和对话级 Runs 标签。

## 复用对话

- 在用户轮次上点**引用 / 复用**开始选取，点**引用至此**结束，即可把这一段作为引用上下文开启新对话，原对话不受影响。
- 选中的片段也可以发送到同一项目的现有对话，或提炼成可编辑的**经验**（适用场景、步骤、验证方式、局限），并可选择存入项目或全局记忆。引用和经验会放进目标对话的输入框，由你确认发送。
- 把侧栏里的对话拖到输入框即可作为引用附上；拖动分组会附上组内全部对话。
- 输入框 `#` 选择器现在能找到已归档和较早的对话，标题匹配优先，偏向当前项目，无结果时会明确提示。
- **会话健康提示**：对话反复压缩且每次腾出的空间越来越少时，提示你拆分会话。**生成交接摘要**会写出可编辑的交接摘要（目标、已完成工作、决定、待办），并用它开启新会话。
- Agent 可以为自己的对话**开一个分支**，保留到目前为止的全部内容，交给你和该分支的 Agent 继续；原对话不会等待它。

## 项目备忘录

- 项目内只给自己看的笔记：踩过的坑、常用开场 prompt、某台服务器的用法。在右侧栏**备忘录**标签或 `/memo` 选择器中打开。
- Agent 永远读不到备忘录：不注入对话，不暴露给任何工具，不写入工作目录，也不进入回顾和导出。只有你自己粘进输入框并发送时，内容才会到达模型。详见[项目备忘录](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/project-memos.md)。

## Run 与计算

- 进行中的 Run 卡片新增**转到后台**：结束本轮对 Run 的等待但不取消 Run。对话可以继续收消息，卡片保持实时状态，Run 结束时会通知你。详见 [Run 卡片](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/run-cards.md)。
- 对话右侧栏新增 **Runs** 标签，列出本对话的 Run 和传输，进行中的排在前面并显示数量。
- **集群调度器**：`sbatch`、`qsub`、`bsub` 作业通过 SSH Run 包装脚本提交，Run 跟踪真实作业的退出码和日志，取消 Run 即取消作业。
- 解释器冷启动较慢（例如 R 加载 Bioconductor 包）时，`run_in_context` 预检不再失败。Windows 上 stderr 合并进管道的成功命令，`shell` 工具不再报告退出码 1。

## Agent 与委派

- 内置对话始终可以委派任务。输入框的「委派」开关和「委派任务」设置已移除；Agent 按每次调用决定是否在后台运行，后台结果送达后一定会唤醒主 Agent。输入框 Agent 菜单重新分组。
- 子代理继承父对话的模型、推理强度和服务档位。删除父对话时可以连同子代理、分支及其产物一起删除。
- 失败的 Reader 任务可以在并行任务卡片、**Agents → 并行任务**或该助手页面上原地重试；Reader 遇到格式错误或不完整的 JSON 会重试一次。
- 持续性探索改由子代理承担，不再落入有时限的工作流。工作流重试会获得新的时限；本地桌面工作流不再隐式继承 600 秒时限和 256,000 token 预算，超时后保留已用量统计，并重试 HTTP 200 响应里包裹的上游错误。
- **专家**可以导出、导入为 `.wisp-specialist.json` 文件（**设置 → 专家 → 新建专家 → 从文件导入…**）。已删除的专家、模型配置和工作流模板 ID 不再复用。
- **研究助理**把选中的项目当作提问范围，而不是重读该项目的全部对话；「项目进展到哪了」由每日研究回顾更新的项目进度记忆来回答。

## 模型与设置

- **设置 → 模型 → 决策模型**：配置 System One 决策模型（TypeSafe Jev、Bamboo 托管或自部署的 StartLux，或自定义服务），供 `map_items` 的 decide 步骤和 `desktop_autopilot` 使用。详见[模型配置](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/model-configuration.md)。
- Command Code 等网关模型会根据 models.dev 的 API 地址自动识别上下文上限和推理档位。
- **设置 → 常规 → 通知与更新**新增**提示音**：任务完成、失败或需要审批时播放所选提示音。默认关闭，与桌面通知相互独立；WinUI 也提供同样的设置。
- 项目卡片分别显示**待处理**和**运行中**数量；侧栏条目显示状态文字，**待处理**筛选会列出项目内全部待处理对话。
- 对话、侧栏和桌宠中的 Agent 状态颜色与动效保持一致，并遵循「减少动态效果」设置。

## 稳定性

- 项目数据库损坏（SQLite code 11 / 26）时，损坏文件会改名为 `project.sqlite.corrupt-<时间>` 保留，并用 `backups/` 中最新的每日副本恢复，没有副本时重建空库，同时说明保住和丢失了什么。详见[数据库自动副本](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.21.0/docs/upgrade-backups.zh-CN.md)。
- macOS：通知不再在主线程留下常驻轮询定时器（此前会让 `usernoted` 占用 CPU 升高，运行数小时后可能卡死）。安装版现在会写入 `wisp.log`。
- 浏览器扩展在没有浏览器窗口时会新开窗口，并能从半开的桥接连接中恢复。
- 备忘录编辑器输入时不再丢失焦点。WinUI 首次启动时若主机数据库尚未就绪，会自动恢复。

## 移动端与原生客户端

- iOS 和 Android 新增按设备保存的信息详细程度（简洁 / 标准 / 详细）。
- SwiftUI 对话在内容更新时保留工具折叠和选中状态。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的签名、公证 DMG，兼容安装支持应用内更新；另提供 SwiftUI 版 DMG 和校验文件。
- **Windows**：常规 MSI / NSIS 安装包在正式签名关闭期间仍未签名；WinUI 3 预览安装包由独立发布工作流构建。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **移动端**：[签名 Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.21.0/wisp-science_1.21.0_android.apk) 可直接覆盖安装旧版本；iOS 通过 Xcode 安装。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.21.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64、arm64。

各平台流水线完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。
